description.text:
BananaMind V2.5 Content Safety is a text-only content-safety classification model fine-tuned from [`google/gemma-4-E2B-it`](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-E2B-it).

The model is designed to classify an input prompt as either `Safe` or `Unsafe`. For unsafe inputs, it also returns the violated safety categories.

output_type.quote: Model type: Instruction-tuned generative safety classifier

quotes: The model is designed to classify an input prompt as either `Safe` or `Unsafe`.

serving.system_prompt:
You are a strict content-safety classifier.

Classify the input as Safe or Unsafe.

Return exactly one of these formats:

Safe

or:

Unsafe
Violated Categories: <categories>
serving.notes: The usage example sets do_sample false and max_new_tokens 80, and the card says to use deterministic decoding for classification. The classifier instructions are placed in the user turn, not as a default in chat_template.jinja. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. text_config.max_position_embeddings is 131072. The architecture is Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration and still contains vision and audio configs. Safetensors reports 5104297539 BF16 parameters; the card does not state a parameter count. No adapter_config.json is in the repository.

evaluation_reported.text: Overall error rate 5.12% on the test data. Peak cumulative error rate 10.0% early in the sweep; later cumulative error rate approximately 5.0-5.1%. Same ordering versus ShieldGemma: BananaMind V2.5 5.12%, ShieldGemma 2B 35.30%, ShieldGemma 9B 40.96%, ShieldGemma 27B 8-bit 52.46%. The test-set size is not stated.
